# Matching evaluation set (spec 018, SC-004)

Manual AI evaluation (constitution §6). For each case, capture the text into a notebook whose
catalog holds the names in the "Catalog" column, then check the ingredient line's label. A case
passes when the line shows "matched: <Expected>" without a member change.

SC-004 target: at least 90% of cases pass.

| Case file | Catalog | Expected entry |
|---|---|---|
| plural_onions.txt | onion | onion |
| plural_tomatoes.txt | tomato | tomato |
| plural_berries.txt | berry | berry |
| plural_bay_leaves.txt | bay leaf | bay leaf |
| case_onion_upper.txt | onion | onion |
| spacing_red_onion.txt | red onion | red onion |
| spanish_cebollas.txt | cebolla | cebolla |
| spanish_limones.txt | limon | limon |
